The current implementation targets three-dimensional Cartesian datasets from MPI-AMRVAC and compatible AGILE snapshots, preserving the native AMR hierarchy and connecting complementary scientific diagnostics within a common numerical representation. The framework combines Python workflow interfaces with compiled Cython kernels, supporting efficient analysis on AMR meshes. We compare native AMR analysis with a VTK point-data conversion and uniform-grid resampling, which shows that changes in data association, interpolation support, and differentiation scale affect both sampled magnetic fields and derived current densities. Small differences in the sampled primary field can become more pronounced in derivative-based quantities, particularly near coarse-fine interfaces. The applications combine field diagnostics, tracing, regional statistics, and line-of-sight integration on the same native AMR representation. simesh makes these operations available through reusable Python interfaces for reproducible analysis of multiscale simulation data.

entries.title: Ballistic mixing: stellar mergers drive internal mixing in extremely massive stars, with implications for proto-globular cluster pollution
entries.abstract: Extremely massive stars, with masses of $10^3$-$10^4$ M$_\odot$, have been proposed as potential sources of the chemical enrichment associated with multiple populations in globular clusters. Early on the main sequence, these stars reach central temperatures of 65 to 75 MK, enabling nucleosynthesis through the CNO, NeNa, and MgAl cycles, producing abundance patterns similar to those observed in the so-called cluster's second population. Stellar mergers are among the leading formation channels for extremely massive stars. In this work, we follow the formation of a $\sim6700$ M$_\odot$ star via 253 stellar mergers, drawn from a direct $N$-body star cluster simulation with properties similar to the densest star clusters observed at redshift $z\sim10$. We evolve each star as a 1D stellar model and construct the merger products from mixing and shock heating prescriptions calibrated to 3D simulations of parabolic collisions. We find that entropy-based mixing efficiently transports nuclear-processed material from the convective core to the envelope, while merger-driven heating promotes chemical homogenization. As a result, the stellar surface becomes enriched with H-burning products, producing abundance patterns consistent with those observed in globular cluster multiple populations and supporting the role of merger-formed extremely massive stars as potential sources of early chemical enrichment in proto-globular cluster-like conditions.

entries.title: Lasting mEMRIs: Signatures of Multiple Black Hole Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals from AGN discs
entries.abstract: Encounters of stellar-mass black holes (sBH) in active galactic nuclei discs naturally form mean-motion resonances of sBH pairs. These mean-motion resonances can be broken close to the central supermassive black hole when gravitational-wave emission dominates over gas torques. We derive a simple condition that depends only on the sBH mass ratio and the resonance index for which a pair of sBH in a mean-motion resonance will remain intact and can be detectable as a multiple Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals (mEMRIs) in the LISA band. We present for the first time the gravitational-wave strain signatures of a pair of co-migrating sBH in mean-motion resonance, including additional gravitational-wave harmonics associated with orbital conjunctions of the individual EMRIs. The frequency evolution and the associated chirp mass is degenerate with isolated EMRIs of different masses. However, the mEMRI mass ratio is quantised by the resonance order and is larger than the true mass ratio. The degeneracy can be broken if the true sBH mass ratio can be inferred from individual strain amplitudes. We argue that mEMRIs should be common if disc driven EMRIs are to be detected by LISA, with $\sim 10$ mEMRIs per year in the local universe ($z \lesssim 0.2$), highlighting the need to model mEMRI systems in future LISA data analysis.

entries.title: FEAST: Spatially Resolved Star Formation History of the NGC 4485/NGC 4490 System and its Tidal Bridge from JWST/NIRCam Color Magnitude Diagrams
entries.abstract: We present the spatially resolved star formation history (SFH) of the interacting, low-mass, gas-rich galaxy pair NGC 4485/NGC 4490, based on deep JWST/NIRCam imaging obtained as part of the FEAST program. Using resolved stars' near-infrared color-magnitude diagrams (CMDs) and the SFERA 2.0 CMD fitting code, we reconstruct the SFH of the system, including the tidal bridge connecting the two galaxies. We find that recent star formation is widespread across the system, extending beyond the main bodies of the galaxies into the tidal bridge and other off-center areas. In particular, a significant fraction of the recent star formation in NGC 4485 occurs outside its central region. All major regions of the system exhibit two prominent episodes of enhanced star formation, occurring around 0.5-1 Gyr and 10-30 Myr ago, with the tidal bridge showing the largest increase relative to its average star formation rate. These peaks in star formation activity occur a few hundred million years after the epochs of the first and second pericenter passages predicted by independent dynamical models, supporting a scenario in which repeated tidal interactions triggered the observed bursts through gas redistribution and compression. Our results place direct observational constraints on the formation history of NGC 4485/NGC 4490 and provide evidence for the important role of galaxy interactions in driving spatially extended, bursty star formation in low-mass galaxies.

entries.title: Data-driven characterisation of variable source light curves with multimodal representation learning
entries.abstract: Surveys such as the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) and the Vera C. Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) produce light curves for hundreds of millions of variables. Their characterisation traditionally relies on supervised classifiers with hand-crafted features and curated labels, limiting them to predefined taxonomies and individual surveys. We present a general, survey-agnostic framework that characterises variable sources without labelled training data, producing low-dimensional representations of light curve properties such as amplitude, periodicity, and asymmetry. A multimodal architecture combines two complementary views, a Transformer encoder on raw observations and a convolutional neural network on a generalised Lomb-Scargle periodogram. Each light curve is randomly split into two temporal halves as independent views, and the branches are trained jointly with VICReg to produce embeddings invariant across halves while keeping each dimension informative. We evaluate on 37 006 ZTF sources spanning 14 variable star classes in four broad physical categories. A linear classifier on the frozen 64-dimensional embeddings achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy for classes and 90.5% for broad categories. Combining both branches improves balanced accuracy by up to 14.9 percentage points over the best single modality, confirming their complementarity. Interpretable light curve properties are encoded on distinct dimensions, and within-class analysis reveals physical substructure unresolved by reference labels. Retraining on ZTF g and i bands without modification reproduces the main results, and concatenating multi-band embeddings improves balanced accuracy to 86.1%. The framework needs no labels, phase folding, or survey-specific preprocessing and applies directly to other surveys with different cadences and wavelength coverage.

entries.title: Searches for coincident Gravitational Waves and High-Energy Neutrinos from the KM3NeT and ANTARES telescopes during O3
entries.abstract: Various models predict that gravitational-wave sources produce high-energy neutrinos. Among them are compact binary coalescences with at least one neutron star, but also core-collapse supernovae or accretion disk instabilities. Two different analyses are presented, combining data from the LIGO and Virgo gravitational-wave detectors with those from the ANTARES and ORCA neutrino telescopes observed during the third observing run of LIGO-Virgo. In the first analysis, selected high-energy neutrino candidates were used as triggers to search for gravitational-wave candidates. In the second analysis, a search was conducted for potential spatial and temporal coincidences between subthreshold high-energy neutrino candidate events and subthreshold gravitational-wave candidates emitted by compact binary coalescence systems. In both searches, no significant coincidences were found. Upper limits on the rate of sources emitting both high-energy neutrinos and gravitational waves are presented. In particular, with the joint search, a joint source rate density upper limit of $8.8\times10^2~\mathrm{ Gpc^{-3}yr^{-1}}$ was found for a typical binary neutron star coalescence with a GW emitted energy of $10^{-1}~\rm M_\odot c^2$ and an isotropic energy emitted in neutrinos of $10^{51}~$erg.

entries.title: Radio and high-energy variable emission from a multi-wavelength follow-up of the infant planet-hosting star V1298 Tau
entries.abstract: V1298 Tau is a very young and magnetically active K1V star which hosts a benchmark multi-planetary system to study planet formation and evolutionary history at the earliest stages. Between 2025 and 2026, we conducted a campaign to monitor the variability of V1298 Tau in radio (band C), X-ray, and NUV bands, with the support of publicly available contemporary optical light curve, and to investigate multi-band correlations to link the emission with stellar activity. Radio observations were carried out with the Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array (JVLA) in band C (4.5--6.5 GHz). X-ray and NUV observations were carried out with the Swift satellite over 20 days, ending one month before the begin of the radio campaign. We analysed the temporal variability of peak (integrated) fluxes in the C-band and of X-ray (NUV) luminosities on various timescales, comparing it with the variability observed in the high-cadence optical light curve collected by the ASAS-SN survey. We observed both radio and high-energy time variable emission. JVLA detected emission in 90\% of the visits, switching between high ($\geq$0.1 mJy/beam) and low flux states in matter of days or hours. The fluxes show moderate correlation with the optical light curve, suggesting modulation with the stellar rotation period. Except for one visit, dynamic spectral analysis does not reveal short-term (minutes) variability, nor is there any evidence of circularly polarised emissions. Overall, the radio observations can be explained as gyrosynchrotron and/or cyclotron emission from the corona, and linked to stellar magnetic activity. At high-energy, we detected significant variability in X-ray luminosity (within the range ~1.2--2.5x10$^{+30}$ erg/s), the decay phase of a stellar flare, and evidence of correlation with the optical flux. Our data confirm that V1298\,Tau follows the near-linear Güdel-Benz relation.

entries.title: Domain models of turbulent magnetic fields and the spectral shape of ensemble averaged axion-photon conversion
entries.abstract: Axion-like particles are light pseudoscalars that appear in many extensions of the Standard Model and are candidates for dark matter. Through their mixing with photons, they imprint energy dependent modulations on the spectra of astrophysical sources shining through magnetised media. When a distant source shines through the turbulent magnetic field of an intervening galaxy cluster, these modulations are stochastic. It has recently been shown that averaging over an ensemble of such sources instead produces a smooth absorption-like feature. In this work we derive the analytic form of this ensemble averaged signal, previously known only numerically. We further relate the index $a$ of the magnetic field energy spectrum to the index $β$ of the domain size distribution that simulations use to describe the turbulent field. For $1<a<2$ the two indices obey the simple analytic relation $β=3-a$. Any distribution with $β<1$ instead mimics the spectral index $a=2$, which the sharp domain walls impose. For Kolmogorov turbulence, relevant for galaxy clusters, the relation gives $β=4/3$.

entries.title: HETDEX [OII] galaxies at $z \le 0.48$: Growth of structures from power spectrum multipoles
entries.abstract: We use the monopole and quadrupole power spectra of [\ion{O}{2}]-emitting galaxies in the HETDEX Public Data Release 1 to constrain the growth of cosmic structures at $z\le0.48$. We interpret the power spectra using a simulation-based model built from the Mucho-Uchuu-1G $N$-body simulation. The best-fit model reproduces the observed power spectra remarkably well up to $k_\mathrm{max}=0.7~h~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$, and goodness-of-fit tests confirm that the HETDEX [\ion{O}{2}] clustering is consistent with the \textit{Planck} flat $Λ$CDM cosmology. We test the general relativity (GR) prediction for the linear growth index, $γ\simeq 0.55$. When the Alcock-Paczyński parameters are held fixed at their fiducial values, we find consistency with the GR prediction, $γ=0.55\pm 0.05$. And, when the AP parameters are allowed to vary, $γ=0.60\pm 0.07$, which is consistent with both the GR prediction and the suppressed growth rate reported by \citet{Nguyen_2023}. These results establish HETDEX [\ion{O}{2}] galaxies as a competitive, independent low-redshift probe of the growth of structures and motivate future full cosmological inference.

entries.title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). Data processing for intracluster light measurements
entries.abstract: The Euclid survey provides images with extraordinary potential for studies of the low-surface-brightness Universe, including intracluster light (ICL). However, to realise this promise, the data must be carefully treated to minimise background variations while preserving the signal from diffuse structures. In this work, we describe the post-processing and measurement procedures used for studies of ICL with Euclid. We demonstrate that we are able to substantially reduce background variations without resorting to a small-scale background subtraction. By injecting simulated clusters into the real images, we show that our approach preserves the faint outskirts of extended sources. On scales of several arcminutes, we can reliably detect surface-brightness levels around 27.5 mag arcsec$^{-2}$ in $Y_\textrm{E}$, $J_\textrm{E}$, $H_\textrm{E}$, and 29 mag arcsec$^{-2}$ in $I_\textrm{E}$. As a result, we can obtain accurate measurements of the ICL in individual clusters from the local Universe out to z~0.8 with uncertainties on the order of 10% in surface brightness, 10 degrees in position angle, and 0.1 in ellipticity. Our ability to measure the diffuse light with Euclid is thus set to meet expectations and revolutionise our understanding of the ICL.

entries.title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). The shape of cluster haloes revealed by intracluster light
entries.abstract: Intracluster light (ICL) offers a luminous route for measuring the shapes and orientations of cluster haloes. We used Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1) images to quantify ICL shapes for 205 clusters at $0.1 \leq z \leq 0.8$ selected from the eROSITA All-Sky Survey and the Dark Energy Survey. We measured the ICL properties across five bands ($I_\mathrm{E}$, $Y_\mathrm{E}$, $J_\mathrm{E}$, $H_\mathrm{E}$ and the coadded $YJH_\mathrm{E}$), and find that the shape parameters are consistent across the filters, with the $H_\mathrm{E}$ band probing the profiles to the largest cluster-centric distances ($0.1R_{200\mathrm{c}}\sim100$ kpc). The ICL ellipticity ($e=1-b/a$) distribution peaks at 0.5, consistent with halo ellipticities inferred from strong and weak lensing studies, suggesting that the ICL traces the large-scale structure of the clusters. Cluster cores, dominated by brightest cluster galaxy (BCG) light, are round ($e\sim0.2$), while the ICL becomes progressively more elongated at large radii, reaching an ellipticity of $\sim0.5$ by $0.1R_{200\mathrm{c}}$. We find that the ICL is closely aligned with the BCG (87% lie within 30$^\circ$), but shows a weaker alignment with the satellite galaxy distribution (61% within 30$^\circ$). Robust position angles could be measured using the ICL for 63% of the sample, whereas position angles could be measured for only 30% of the sample using the satellite galaxies. Stacking clusters in redshift bins allows measurements of the ICL surface brightness to $0.6$-$0.8R_{200\mathrm{c}}$ and ellipticity beyond $0.3$-$0.4R_{200\mathrm{c}}$ (300-400 kpc), but we observed a plateau in the ICL ellipticity beyond $0.1R_{200\mathrm{c}}$. These results demonstrate the capability of Euclid to characterise the ICL morphology with high statistical precision, allowing new constraints on cluster halo structure and its evolution with redshift.

entries.title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). A systematic study of the intracluster light fraction at 0.2 < z < 1.5
entries.abstract: We present a homogeneous analysis of the intracluster light (ICL) in approximately 300 galaxy clusters spanning $0.2<z<1.5$, combining Sunyaev-Zeldovich-selected clusters from the South Pole Telescope and optically selected clusters from Euclid, and comparing results with Hydrangea simulations. We measured the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG) within elliptical isophotes of semi-major axis 50 kpc, and ICL between 50 and 200 kpc. We show that the Euclid Wide Survey can detect ICL in individual massive clusters ($M_{500} \gtrsim 10^{14.2}\,M_{\odot}$) out to at least $z\sim1.5$, with detection rates of 70-80%. This indicates that diffuse stellar envelopes are common, although not ubiquitous, in massive clusters throughout this redshift range. Using a uniform methodology, we place improved constraints on ICL fraction evolution. ICL contributes about 40% of the combined BCG and ICL light and 20% of the total cluster stellar light, with both fractions remaining approximately constant across $0.2<z<1.5$ at fixed cluster mass. This implies that the relative partitioning of stellar mass between the BCG, ICL, and satellite populations is largely established by $z\sim1.5$. However, the ICL properties of individual clusters may still change as they evolve, since the sample does not represent an evolutionary sequence. This behaviour is consistent with a scenario in which the BCG and ICL are assembled together through the accretion, stripping, and eventual merging of the same population of massive galaxies ($>10^{10}\,M_\odot$). The inferred ICL fraction also depends systematically on wavelength, while remaining largely insensitive to the adopted outer integration radius of 200-600 kpc. These results highlight the importance of homogeneous ICL analyses and constrain the evolution of diffuse stellar components in clusters.

entries.title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). The metallicity of the intracluster light
entries.abstract: Colour provides key information to constrain the stellar population of the intracluster light (ICL), the diffuse light within galaxy clusters. We derive radial colour profiles ($Y_\mathrm{E}-H_\mathrm{E}$, $J_\mathrm{E}-H_\mathrm{E}$, $I_\mathrm{E}-H_\mathrm{E}$) of the brightest central galaxy (BCG) and ICL for 168 galaxy clusters from the Dark Energy Survey redMaPPer catalogue within the redshift range $0.1 < z < 0.75$ and halo mass $M_{\rm 200m} > 10^{14.05}M_\odot/h$, within the Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). By stacking the light profiles measured using elliptical annuli on the BCG and ICL images, we reliably measure the ICL colour out to approximately 300 kpc, over which we find a colour gradient, with the ICL becoming bluer than the BCG out to approximately 150 kpc. Using stellar population synthesis (SPS) models, we find that near-infrared (NIR) colours are sensitive to metallicity, but not age. Thus, we measure a metallicity profile in the BCG and ICL that extends out to 300 kpc for a statistical sample for the first time. While the colours, and the detection of a colour and metallicity gradient, are robust, we note that our metallicity measurement is dependent upon our choice of both SPS model and colour. We find that the metallicity of the BCG is super-solar [$\log_{10} (Z/Z_\odot) > 0.1$], while the ICL is metal-poor [$\log_{10}(Z/Z_\odot)\approx -0.5$], placing the first statistical constraint on the metallicity of the ICL out to large radii. These results support our current understanding of BCG and ICL formation: BCGs form predominantly through mergers with massive galaxies or the cores of satellite galaxies, while the ICL grows via the tidal stripping of lower-metallicity stars from the outskirts of massive satellite galaxies.

entries.title: Stellar Loci X: Selection of Nitrogen-Rich Giants Using GALEX NUV and Synthetic SDSS Photometry
entries.abstract: Nitrogen-rich (N-rich) field stars (likely second-generation escapees from globular clusters) provide a powerful, but currently sample-limited, probe of globular-cluster disruption in the Galactic halo. We exploit the fact that enhanced NH, CN absorption depresses optical u band flux, while the near-ultraviolet (NUV) band is largely insensitive to nitrogen enhancement while remaining sensitive to overall metallicity. Combining GALEX NUV photometry with (synthetic) SDSS optical photometry, we construct a [Fe/H]-dependent stellar-locus model for giants and select significant redder u-g outliers as N-rich candidates. For a relaxed cut ([Fe/H] <= -0.8, 2 sigma) we identify 970 candidates, with an estimated completeness of 64-65% and purity of 41-62% from multiple validations. A stricter selection ([Fe/H] <= -1.0, 3 sigma) yields 220 candidates, with lower completeness (30-38%) but substantially higher purity (60-91%). The dominant contaminants show anomalous spectral energy distributions (e.g., UV excess), and are themselves useful targets for follow-up. The diverse kinematic and dynamical properties of our candidates suggest multiple origins. This scalable photometric approach enables systematic searches for N-rich halo stars and is well suited to forthcoming wide-field surveys such as CSST.

entries.title: Coronal spectroscopy - Past, Present and Future
entries.abstract: After the beginning of photography of solar corona during the eclipses in the year 1860, efforts began to carry out spectroscopic observations of solar corona. During the total solar eclipse of 1868 August 18 at Guntur, Madras state, the observation of emission line 5875Å by Janssen lead to the discovery of Helium. Next year, during the eclipse of 1869 August 7, Charles Young and William Harkness discovered green emission line around 5310Å (later measured as 5303Å). It was interpreted as due to Coronium, an unknown element. The identification of this green line in 1939 due to [Fe xiv] ion showed the corona to be hot at 10^6 K. High resolution spectroscopic observations indicated that width of emission lines to be more than expected. The excess line width was interpreted in terms of existence of non-thermal velocity. Recent spectroscopic observations have indicated a complex nature of variation of emission line parameters with height above the corona. The spectroscopy of solar corona is also performed in other wavelengths, such as UV, EUV, X-rays, visible, infrared, and radio part of the spectrum. Here, we discuss the past spectroscopic observations of solar corona, present observations with various instruments, such as Visible Emission Line Coronagraph onboard Aditya-L1, and need for the spectroscopic observations in future.

entries.title: SpinOctopus: A Versatile, User-Friendly, and Extensible Public Code for General-Relativistic Ray-Tracing in axisymmetric spacetime
entries.abstract: Relativistic ray-tracing algorithms serve as indispensable numerical tools for investigating gravitational theories and high-energy astrophysics. In this paper, we develop and release SpinOctopus, a versatile relativistic ray-tracing code tailored for arbitrary axisymmetric spacetimes, powered by a Fortran/Python hybrid architecture and OpenMP multi-threading acceleration. This numerical toolkit is capable of simulating timelike orbits and their corresponding light curves, null geodesics, as well as black hole images illuminated by a wide array of phenomenological sources, including geometrically thin and thick accretion disks, geometrically thin tilted disks, relativistic jets, spherically symmetric accretion flows, and point sources. To execute these tasks, users are solely required to specify the covariant metric tensor of the target spacetime and the simulation parameters within a dedicated configuration file. Benefiting from our customized adaptive step-size strategy for geodesic integration, SpinOctopus achieves an impressive processing efficiency of $\sim 800$ rays per second per thread on an Intel Core i7-14700 platform when simulating geometrically thick accretion disk images. Furthermore, the code provides transparent interfaces, allowing users to seamlessly modify the geometric and kinematic properties of the light sources. Additional capabilities, such as simulating Fe K$α$ fluorescent line profiles and geometrically thick tilted accretion disk images, will be introduced in future releases of the framework.

entries.title: Neutron Star-Main-Sequence Star Collision: Formation and Long-Term Evolution of Thorne-Żytkow Objects
entries.abstract: Thorne-$\dot{\mathrm{Z}}$ytkow objects (T$\dot{\mathrm{Z}}$Os) are stars containing a neutron-star (NS) or black-hole (BH) core embedded in a stellar envelope and powered primarily by mass accretion onto the core. Classical evolution models of T$\dot{\mathrm{Z}}$Os begin with an assumed equilibrium configuration and predict chemical anomalies in the stellar envelope resulting from nuclear burning in the vicinity of the NS core. Here we connect dynamical formation to long-term evolution by combining a three-dimensional simulation of a post-supernova collision between a $1.4M_\odot$ NS and a $10M_\odot$ main-sequence star with a subsequent stellar evolution calculation using MESA. The collision successfully produces a bound, quasi-spherical T$\dot{\mathrm{Z}}$O with the NS settled at the center of the stellar envelope. In contrast to the classical picture, the collision heats a substantial fraction of the star and leads to widespread nuclear burning during the subsequent thermal-relaxation phase. As the envelope becomes convective, material processed by the carbon-nitrogen cycle is transported to the surface, leaving a potentially observable chemical imprint of formation that persists after the star attains the standard accretion-supported T$\dot{\mathrm{Z}}$O structure. At the end of our simulation, the stellar luminosity greatly exceeds Eddington in the outer envelope, suggesting that significant mass ejection will occur, leaving behind an isolated NS or BH.

entries.title: PSR J0653+0443: An Eclipsing Millisecond Pulsar in an Extremely Eccentric Double Neutron Star System
entries.abstract: Double neutron star (DNS) systems emit gravitational waves (GW) as they orbit each other, with waveforms dependent on their orbital properties \cite{Poisson+2014grav.book.....P}. The number of DNS systems surviving binary star evolution in the Milky Way and the distribution of their orbital parameters are fundamental questions for GW astronomy and binary evolution studies. Here, we report the discovery of a new Galactic field DNS system, PSR J0653+0443, comprising two ~1.4 $M_\odot$ components in an extremely eccentric orbit $e=0.992387$, $P_{\rm orb}=79.084$ d. Its unique orbital dynamics include a 46-minute transit from true anomaly $θ=-90^\circ$ to $90^\circ$ and striking periastron relative motion (maximum acceleration 1.11~km~s$^{-2}$, peak speed 1.14$\times$10$^6$~m~s$^{-1}$. The pulsar undergoes an 85-second conjunction eclipse, indicating a nearly edge-on binary orbit. Short-term variations in the periastron advance induce significant pulse arrival time modulation spanning -2.91 to +2.49 ms --- at least an order of magnitude larger than that observed in any other DNS system. From this modulation, the non-relativistic periastron advance rate is constrained to $-1.5^{+0.9}_{-0.8}\times10^{-4}$ deg yr$^{-1}$. The extreme orbital eccentricity can only be attributed to a large kick velocity imparted during the iron-core collapse supernova of the progenitor of the second component. The predicted detection probability of such a PSR J0653+0443-like DNS system is $\lesssim 5 \times 10^{-3}$, implying that our discovery of this system challenges current understanding of binary evolution. This extraordinary DNS system emits periodic gravitational wave bursts, with the GW energy flux peaking at 0.357 mHz. This makes it an ideal target for the future LISAmax mission.

entries.title: Evaluating Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection for Identifying Unusual Galaxy Morphologies in CEERS and NGDEEP
entries.abstract: Galaxy morphology out to $z\sim 6$ provides insight into galaxy formation and evolution, but identifying rare or structurally complex systems is difficult due to observational limits and the scale of modern imaging surveys. Here, we apply AdaCLIP, a Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) model built upon the Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) model and adapted using non-astronomical anomaly-detection datasets, to identify structurally unusual galaxies without galaxy-specific anomaly-detection training or morphological labels. We extract anomaly scores and 768-dimensional feature embeddings from 38,853 galaxies in the Cosmic Evolution Early Release Science (CEERS) and Next Generation Deep Extragalactic Exploratory Public (NGDEEP) surveys, and compare the resulting anomaly scores with parametric GALFIT and nonparametric statmorph measurements. The feature embeddings reveal structure associated with galaxy morphology and observational properties, while anomaly scores show modest trends with structural measures, including asymmetry, concentration, $M_{20}$, and size, but weaker or less consistent trends with Sérsic index, axis ratio, smoothness, and Gini coefficient. These results highlight the potential of ZSAD as a scalable tool for identifying unusual galaxy morphologies in large astronomical imaging surveys, including those anticipated from the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.

entries.title: A Little Red Dot emerging from a nitrogen-rich UV-luminous galaxy with Very Massive Stars
entries.abstract: JWST is revealing abundant populations of high-$z$ galaxies with unforeseen properties: UV-luminous galaxies with high nitrogen enrichment, populations of very massive stars (VMSs; $>100\ M_\odot$), and early forms of massive black hole growth such as the Little Red Dots (LRDs). Here we present all these phenomena appearing simultaneously in COLA1, a luminous ($M_{\rm UV}=-21.3$) galaxy at $z=6.6$. New NIRSpec medium-resolution data reveal a blue UV continuum ($β_{\rm UV}=-2.5$) with strong emission lines including NIV] $\lambda1486$, stellar P Cygni profiles, and broad HeII $\lambda1640$. We fit the UV with stellar population models, and find that the models including VMSs (limited to $300\ M_\odot$) are statistically preferred. The best-fit stellar population has $M_*\approx10^8\ M_\odot$, and a young age of $2.4\pm0.8$ Myr. The rest-optical shows a redder continuum ($β_{\rm opt}=-1.1$) and broad Balmer lines with Balmer absorption akin to LRD spectra. By evolving the best-fit stellar population we find that the UV could dim by 1-2 mag in $\sim5$ Myr, and hence this system would be observed as a typical V-shaped LRD. We measure a supersolar $\rm log_{10}(N/O)=-0.07\pm0.05$ and subsolar $\rm log_{10}(C/O)=-0.64\pm0.11$; therefore $\rm log_{10}(N/C)=+0.58\pm0.12$. The independent density-sensitive NIV] $λ\lambda1483,1486$ and CIII] $λ\lambda1906/1909$ ratios require two zones with $n_e\gtrsim10^{6.5}$ cm$^{-3}$ and $n_e\lesssim10^{3.5}$ cm$^{-3}$, respectively. We estimate $\rm log_{10}(N/C)>1.3$ (2$σ$) for the dense zone, requiring extreme N/C enrichment mechanisms such as highly rotating $>100\ M_\odot$ VMSs, tidal disruption events, or supermassive stars. We speculate that runaway collisions of massive stars in a dense stellar cluster may have lead to the seeding of an intermediate-mass black hole resulting in the formation of an LRD.

entries.title: In-orbit anomaly and recovery of IXPE detector 2
entries.abstract: The Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) is a joint NASA-ASI mission launched in December 2021 to measure the linear polarization of celestial X-ray sources in the 2-8 keV energy range. The payload comprises three identical telescopes, each combining grazing-incidence X-ray optics with a focal-plane photoelectric polarimeter based on the Gas Pixel Detector technology. On 14 April 2025, the second detector experienced an anomaly that significantly altered the electrical behavior of the ASIC responsible for reading out the photoelectron track images. In this contribution, we describe the effect of the anomaly on the instrumental response and the actions taken to mitigate its effects and recover the scientific observations of the instrument.

entries.title: Cosmic Ray Observations using Coincident Scintillator and Radio Signals with the Beamforming Elevated Array for COsmic Neutrinos (BEACON)
entries.abstract: At energies above 100 PeV, coherent radio frequency (RF) emission across the 10 -- 1000 MHz band from cosmic particle-induced atmospheric showers becomes increasingly dominant, making radio detection a powerful probe at ultrahigh energies. The Beamforming Elevated Array for COsmic Neutrinos (BEACON) considers mountaintop phased radio arrays to monitor large areas at the horizon for upward-going geomagnetic emission in the 30 -- 80 MHz band produced as a consequence of Earth-skimming tau neutrinos. As part of ongoing efforts to measure the sensitivity of BEACON to such signals, the BEACON prototype identifies cosmic rays through the same emission mechanism. Prior to 2023, BEACON operated a four-antenna prototype, which successfully demonstrated identification of coherent and impulsive sources using a beamforming RF trigger. In 2023, we upgraded the instrument to six newly designed antennas and added an independent scintillator array to cross-validate radio-detectable cosmic rays. This work details the observation of 22 candidate cosmic-ray events in a scintillator-coincidence-triggered dataset using selection cuts based on expected radio characteristics. A simulation of the hybrid-instrument performance verifies this observation rate to within an order of magnitude. We estimate a background of 0.11 events by applying the selection cuts to synthetic datasets of uncorrelated radio-scintillator pairs that are randomly formed using fixed-rate software-triggered data. The reconstructed signal polarization angles are consistent with pure geomagnetic emission compared to various background classes.

entries.title: Rotation slows the instability of Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes
entries.abstract: We present nonlinear 3+1 evolutions of rotating Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes. We construct stationary rotating drainhole solutions with a spectral solver up to an equatorial rotation velocity of 99% of the speed of light, validate the solver against published symmetric solutions, and correct an inconsistency in a published field equation. Perturbed only by truncation error, the evolutions show that rotation slows the radial instability of the static wormhole. Near 30% of the extremal angular momentum the unperturbed throat expands instead of collapsing, rather than the instability disappearing as second-order perturbation theory suggests. From 58% upward we find no evidence of instability over the evolved times; at the fastest spin this holds at three resolutions. Collapsing rotating throats emit an axisymmetric quadrupolar gravitational-wave burst whose energy grows with spin. Second-order perturbative initial data trigger the instability through their own truncation error, so they are unsuitable for stability studies.

entries.title: PBR sensitivity to boosted dark matter explanation for the KM3-230213A event
entries.abstract: POEMMA-Balloon with Radio (PBR) is a hybrid fluorescence and optical Cherenkov telescope that is a pathfinder instrument for a future Probe Of Extreme Multi-Messenger Astrophysics (POEMMA), together with a radio instrument, to be flown on a super pressure balloon in Spring 2028. One of its science objectives is follow up of astrophysical event alerts via signals of tau decays in the atmosphere, sourced by Earth-skimming tau neutrinos. The recent report of the KM3NeT Collaboration's muon event with $ E_μ=120^{+110}_{-60}$ PeV sparked searches for beyond the standard model (BSM) physics explanations. Using a specific, boosted dark matter scenario which together with the KM3NeT observation, sets a scale for the fluence of boosted dark matter in this energy range, we assess the capabilities of PBR to constrain or discover such a source for a boosted dark matter energy spectrum above $\sim 10^8$ GeV. PBR has discovery potential for dark matter energies above $10^9$ GeV, and depending on BSM input parameters, to dark matter energies as low as $1.5\times 10^8$ GeV. While the analysis is focused on one BSM example, the methodology is applicable to any BSM physics that affects tau production in the Earth.

entries.title: The diversity of late-time interaction in Type II supernovae
entries.abstract: Studying core-collapse supernovae (SNe) beyond one year after explosion, when ejecta interaction with circumstellar material (CSM) progressively becomes the dominant power source, offers critical insights into the progenitor mass loss history. Using binary progenitors that underwent different levels of H-rich envelope stripping, we present radiative transfer calculations of the ejecta with CSM interaction in Type IIb, II-L and II-P SN scenarios covering epochs of 1.5 to 3-6yr, with a focus on the UV and optical properties. The impact of CSM interaction is evaluated for a cold-dense shell (CDS) of 0.1-2.0Msun (CDS velocity of ~5000-10000km/s) and shock powers of 1e39-1e41erg/s, producing a grid of about 200 models. We find that Lyalpha, MgII2800, and Halpha are typically the strongest individual lines, MgII2800 being the most constant relative to changes in time and in CDS mass. Lyalpha thrives at low CDS mass and is strongly attenuated otherwise. A large fraction of the emerging UV and optical flux is, however, influenced by a forest of Fe lines, which introduces strong optical depth effects. A myriad of other lines, generally forbidden, are predicted that each contain less than a percent of the total flux. N enrichment yield stronger N lines in the UV and optical. A subset of these models roughly match UV and optical observations of SNe 1993J, 1998S, 2013ej, and 2023ixf at 1.5-3yr, although matching the full range consistently is a challenge, in particular when dust must be invoked. Blue-red asymmetry of line profiles is typical of all lines in the UV, the more so at earlier times or higher CDS mass, even in the absence of dust. In our simulations, optical depth effects, associated with the gas or dust or both, quenches the emission of Lyalpha or [OIII]4958-5007A from regions within or below the CDS.

entries.title: The Structural Anatomy of Galaxies: Environmental Dependence of Morphological and Quenching Evolution at 0.1 < z < 0.5
entries.abstract: We investigate how cluster environments affect galaxy star formation, structure, and stellar populations using spectroscopically-confirmed galaxies in X-ray-selected eROSITA clusters, that have deep HSC-SSP imaging and DESI DR1 spectroscopy. At 0.1<z<0.5, we compare dust-corrected Ha star formation rates (SFRs), effective radii (Re), bulge-to-total light ratios (B/T), and Dn4000 between cluster satellites and a stellar-mass- and redshift-matched field control sample. We identify UVJ-quiescent galaxies and divide the UVJ star-forming population at log(sSFR_Ha)= -10.5 yr-1 into actively star-forming and Ha-low systems, the latter referred to as green-valley (GV) galaxies. Cluster--field differences depend strongly on stellar mass, projected cluster-centric radius, and galaxy population. Cluster star-forming galaxies show modest SFR suppression but weak structural offsets. The strongest coupled signatures occur among Ha-low UVJ-star-forming galaxies, particularly low-mass satellites at R<0.5R500, which have lower SFRs, smaller light-weighted sizes, larger B/T, and larger Dn4000 than matched field counterparts. Quiescent galaxies show weaker structural offsets but retain a positive Dn4000 residual. We quantify the joint signal using a Mahalanobis distance based on matched residuals in SFR, Re, B/T, and Dn4000 with a field--field reference covariance. The multivariate offset is largest for low-mass GV galaxies and decreases toward larger projected radius. The broader radial extent of SFR suppression relative to structural offsets suggests that star-formation suppression has a broader environmental reach than structural transformation. These results show that environmental quenching and structural transformation are most strongly coupled in the Ha-low transition population.

entries.title: Local tests of Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson spacetime
entries.abstract: We study weak field local tests of Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson spacetime, which describes a static black hole embedded in an external magnetic field. Perihelion precession, deflection of light rays and time delay of radar echoes are the phenomena considered in this work to understand the possible effects of this external magnetic field on these observationally important tests. We not only derive weak field analytical results by employing appropriate methods, but also consider an exact approach to directly integrate the relevant geodesic equations, to both confirm those weak field analytical results and to obtain results beyond the weak field approximation.

entries.title: Relation of Rotation and Pulsation Properties in $γ$ Doradus Stars
entries.abstract: Connection between stellar rotation and pulsation amplitude has been proposed for several types of pulsating variable stars, but no such relation has been established for gamma Doradus stars from spectroscopic v sin i measurements. A high-amplitude gamma Dor subclass was also suggested recently, which had not been explored by spectroscopic means before. We investigate the connection between rotation and pulsational properties of gamma Dor stars using a homogeneous spectroscopic sample with available TESS light curves. We obtained new stellar spectra with the ACE spectrograph on the 1-m RCC telescope of Konkoly Observatory and measured v sin i for a sample of 124 targets. For target selection, Gaia classifications were combined with TESS photometry. We used Fourier methods to determine the dominant frequencies from all available TESS light curves through sector 98. We also performed rotation- and inclination-dependent mode visibility modelling relying on GYRE Hough functions with TAR visibilities for the interpretation of our results. We find a decreasing upper envelope in both the peak-to-peak amplitude and the dominant-component semi-amplitude as a function of v sin i: high-v sin i stars show only low photometric amplitudes, whereas high-amplitude stars have low v sin i. We also confirm a positive relation between v sin i and the dominant pulsation frequency. The highest observed amplitudes also decrease towards higher dominant frequencies. Visibility modelling indicates that these trends cannot be explained by geometric effects alone, suggesting that the intrinsic pulsation amplitudes of gamma Dor stars physically decrease with increasing equatorial rotational velocity. Furthermore, the strong suppression of zonal dipole mode visibility at high rotation suggests that high-amplitude gamma Dor stars are likely slow rotators or moderate rotators viewed nearly pole-on.

entries.title: An Implicit Conservative Finite Volume Scheme with Poisson Brackets for the Steady-State Transport of Galactic Cosmic Rays
entries.abstract: Galactic cosmic rays (GCRs) pose a persistent radiation hazard to astronauts and spacecraft in the heliosphere. Modeling their transport is essential for understanding how the solar wind and heliospheric magnetic field shape their spatial distributions and energy spectra. Timely predictions require solving for the particle distribution function much faster than real time, but explicit numerical schemes are restricted by the stability limit on the time step. In this Letter, we present an implicit conservative finite-volume scheme for kinetic equations formulated with Poisson brackets. This scheme conserves particle number, maintains the total-variation-diminishing property, achieves second-order spatial accuracy, and remains stable for time steps far beyond the explicit limit, while reaching quasi-steady states in less than ~1/100 of the computational time required for the explicit scheme, as demonstrated by numerical tests. We apply this scheme to the Parker transport equation along magnetic field lines in the background solar wind during Carrington rotation 2211, where it reaches steady-state GCR distributions within 10 iterations, about 1000 times faster than the explicit scheme. The GCR proton spectrum averaged over 27 days agrees with AMS-02 measurements to within 10%. The simulation also yields a realistic radial intensity gradient and captures the Forbush decrease features associated with three stream interaction regions observed at Earth.

entries.title: Extended vs. thin screen approximation in astrophysical settings
entries.abstract: Context: In the context of radio wave propagation through plasma concentrations and for gravitational lensing, the thin screen approximation often provides a suitable approximation for scattering and deflections caused by three-dimensional spatial structures. For scattering of electromagnetic waves from an extended medium, stochastic theories provide analytical bounds on ensemble averaged quantities, such as the scintillation index. If neither the conditions for a stochastic treatment nor the thin screen approximation are fulfilled, fully numerical methods are required. Aims: For an extended structure, the applicability of the thin screen approximation needs to be verified by comparing it with the fully three-dimensional scattering solution. We discuss various exact solutions to simple lensing geometries and provide numerical results for the propagation in the branched-flow regime, which is also of relevance in astrophysical applications. Methods: We transfer several analytical results obtained in quantum mechanical scattering theory to astrophysical settings and complement them with different numerical methods to quantify the deviations of thin screen theories from an extended medium results. Results: We provide the analytical results for spherical waves scattered by a point source and show the emergence of branchef flow in the intermediate regime between thin screen physics and stochastic media results.

entries.title: Modeling MAD Sgr A* flares and their dependence on spin
entries.abstract: Aims: This study aims to place constraints on the spin of Sgr A* from recent flare observations. It models the flare kinematics in the vicinity of a supermassive black hole, evaluates their dependence on black hole spin, and assesses the correlation between the spin of the black hole and the astrometric observations in the Galactic center. Methods: Our study extends the work of Antonopoulou et al. 2025 to a range of black hole spins. A prominent flux eruption is identified in the simulation, and the evolution of the active region on the equatorial plane is tracked during the event. The flare model consists of a spherical hot spot ejected along the flux tube with a relativistic velocity. Results: In MAD simulations, the flux tube wraps around the jet funnel in the opposite direction to the black hole's spin. This dependence is imprinted on the flare trajectory and provides a strong correlation between the spin of the black and the flare kinematics. This analysis favors Kerr black holes, with a preference towards larger spin magnitude. Although prograde simulations show a consistent clockwise motion in the sky regardless of disk rotation, retrograde models require a clockwise accretion disk to account for the observations of July 22, 2018. Conclusions: A maximally rotating Kerr black hole is the most promising candidate for reproducing the observed flare trajectory in the vicinity of Sgr A*, illustrating a pass faction surpassing $90\%$ among the investigated flare models. In particular, determining spin orientation within this model is linked to the rotation of the accretion disk. Assuming a counterclockwise accretion disk, a prograde black hole with $a\geq1/2$ is able to reproduce the observed flare kinematics in the Galactic center. Conversely, assuming a clockwise rotation for the disk, the observations support both prograde and retrograde Kerr black holes with a large spin.

entries.title: Optimal galaxy magnification: generalized fundamental-plane residuals and number counts are all you need
entries.abstract: Weak-lensing magnification complements cosmic shear through its effects on galaxy fluxes, sizes, and number counts. We derive the optimal magnification statistics from galaxy properties and show that the optimal measurement can be decomposed into an optimal mean statistic and total number counts. The optimal mean statistic can be constructed from the residual distribution of a generalized fundamental plane (GFP), $F(i,\boldsymbol{X})$, which predicts galaxy size or, equivalently, flux from surface brightness $i$ and additional lensing-invariant properties $\boldsymbol{X}$. The function $F$ can take any form that reduces the intrinsic scatter and thereby improves magnification precision. For a Gaussian residual distribution, the optimal mean statistic reduces to the inverse-variance-weighted residual, or simply the residual for constant scatter. Together with total number counts, this statistic captures all the magnification Fisher information under Poisson statistics, achieving the same precision as a full-likelihood analysis. This provides a simple and physically intuitive optimal compression of the full magnification likelihood, avoiding the need to model the potentially high-dimensional galaxy-property distribution, particularly when additional observables are incorporated to reduce the GFP scatter. Our results demonstrate that GFP residuals and number counts provide an optimal combination for weak-lensing magnification measurements in galaxy surveys.

analysis.result: 吸收气体的自发射源函数 $S(\lambda)$ 能选择性填补吸收槽，使得观测等效宽度按 $EW = C[1-\langle S/I_{\rm in}\rangle]EW^*$ 显著缩放。在基态柱密度 $\log(N_2/{\rm cm^{-2}})\sim15{\text{--}}17$ 区间，$n=3$ 能级因仅有 $\mathrm{Ba}\alpha$ 单通道共振跃迁而产生剧烈的辐射俘获（radiative trapping），使得局部源函数比值降至 $\bar{S}_{2,4}/\bar{S}_{2,3} \lesssim 0.06$ 乃至 $\sim 10^{-2}$，自然重现 $(EW/\lambda)_{\mathrm{H}\alpha} < (EW/\lambda)_{\mathrm{H}\beta}$ 的反常反转。拟合 RUBIES-49140 所需吸收体半径为 $R\sim 3.6\times10^{17}{\rm~cm}$，对应维里动力学质量标度为 $M = {b^2 R / G} = 7.5\times10^5\,M_\odot (b/100\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}})^2 (R/10^{18}\,{\rm cm})$。

analysis.problem: 部分小红点（LRDs）光谱中观测到反常的弱 $\mathrm{H}\alpha$ 吸收（等效宽度或线深明显弱于 $\mathrm{H}\beta$），直接违背了基于实验室振子强度比（$f_{2,3}=0.6411$ 对比 $f_{2,4}=0.1194$）的标准吸收生长曲线预期，且共用 $n=2$ 下能级的谱线无法通过传统的部分覆盖因子几何模型解释该反转现象。
analysis.method: 推导了包含局部各向同性源函数 $S(\lambda)$ 的一维辐射转移方程 $I(\lambda) = C I_{\rm in}(\lambda)e^{-\tau(\lambda)} + (1-C)I_{\rm in}(\lambda) + C S(\lambda)(1-e^{-\tau(\lambda)})$；结合微观能级平衡方程与 \textsc{cloudy} 光致电离数值模拟，修正了穿透几率与逃逸几率的时间反演对称性及翼区光深积分，系统计算了考虑源函数修正后的巴尔末线生长曲线。
assumptions: 吸收介质处于维里平衡状态，气体多普勒参数 $b$ 能够表征其引力势阱中的特征动力学速度。

analysis.title_zh: 探索慢自转脉冲星的起源：基于STARS模拟白矮星的辐射
analysis.reason: 文章探讨了慢自转脉冲星（SRP）及超长周期瞬变源（LPT）的白矮星（WD）假说。常规中子星模型推导出的偶极磁场系统性超过Schwinger临界场 $B_c \approx 4.41 \times 10^{13}\,\mathrm{G}$，易抑制电子对产生且落入脉冲星死区；而采用恒星演化程序模拟的磁化WD及其超钱德拉塞卡解能提供自然的自转与磁场参数匹配，有助于高能瞬变源与射电瞬变引擎的理论证认。
analysis.result: 基于一维恒星演化程序 \texttt{STARS} 模拟的白矮星模型，其表面磁场由 $B_s = \sqrt{\frac{3c^3}{8\pi^2}\frac{I}{R^6\sin^2\alpha}P\dot{P}}$ 约束。与中子星解普遍处于超临界磁场（$B_s > B_c = 4.41 \times 10^{13}\,\mathrm{G}$）不同，WD解释下的表面偶极场处于 $B_s \sim 10^8 - 10^{11}\,\mathrm{G}$，落在已知强磁场白矮星范围内；对于慢脉冲星 PSR J0901-4046，超钱德拉塞卡 WD 解（$M \approx 1.62 - 2.05\,M_\odot$，$R \approx 7068 - 4317\,\mathrm{km}$）要求较小磁倾角 $\alpha \approx 2^\circ - 17^\circ$ 及 $B_s \sim 1.02\times 10^9 - 2.68\times 10^{10}\,\mathrm{G}$。
analysis.problem: 慢自转脉冲星（如 PSR J0901-4046）与长周期瞬变源（如 GPM J1839-10、GLEAM-X J1627）若采用经典中子星磁偶极辐射减慢模型解释，推导所得表面磁场普遍超越 Schwinger 临界场且处于死谷深处，导致正负电子对产生被抑制，传统中子星脉冲辐射机制面临严重理论困难。
analysis.method: 使用一维恒星演化代码 \texttt{STARS} 求解加入磁压的结构方程，引入与密度相关的磁场分布剖面 $B(\rho) = B_{\rm s} + B_0[1 - \exp\{-\eta(\rho/\rho_0)^\gamma\}]$（$\rho_0 = 10^9\,\mathrm{g\,cm^{-3}}$），并利用磁偶极辐射公式 $\dot{E}_{\rm em}=(2/3c^3)|\boldsymbol{m}|^2\Omega^4\sin^2\alpha$ 与自转减慢方程匹配已知源的观测周期 $P$ 与周期导数 $\dot{P}$。

analysis.title_zh: 双中子星并合模拟中 M1 中微子反应率的混合神经网络仿真器
analysis.reason: 该工作提出了一种利用轻量神经网络替代高开销 2D 积分核、同时保留解析 1D 反应的混合仿真方案，成功消除了双中子星（BNS）并合通用相对论辐射磁流体（GRMHD）模拟中灰体 M1 中微子反应率的计算瓶颈，显著提升计算吞吐量且完好保持了核合成与千新星诊断相关的电子丰度 $Y_e$ 和外流特征。
analysis.result: 混合方案将总不透明度计算耗时降低约 $8.7$ 倍，NN 前向传播比被替代的 2D 积分核快约 $12$ 倍，使端到端 BNS 模拟全局吞吐量从 $1.085\times 10^7$ 提升至 $2.347\times 10^7\,\mathrm{ZCPS}$（实现 $2.16$ 倍整体加速）。全局合并模拟中中微子峰值光度达 ${\simeq}3.4\times10^{53}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$，与基准积分模拟相比光度差异 $\lesssim 5\%$，平均能量差异 $\lesssim 1\%$；非束缚抛射物质量吻合在 $10\%$ 以内（$2.32\times10^{-3}\,M_\odot$ 对 $2.54\times10^{-3}\,M_\odot$），质权平均电子丰度仅相差 $\Delta Y_e = 0.012$（$0.348$ 对 $0.336$）。
analysis.problem: 在 BNS 并合的灰体 M1 中微子辐射转移模拟中，包含成对湮灭、韧致辐射和非弹性散射等 $\mathcal{O}(N_q^2)$ 复杂度的 2D 相空间积分核极其耗时，占据了总不透明度计算时间的 $96\%$ 以上以及整机 GRMHD 运算的 $70.4\%$，成为全尺度多信使模拟的关键计算瓶颈。
limits: 网络容量在当前数据分布下接近饱和，残余误差集中在极端热力学边缘和重轻子味（$\mu, \tau$）区域

analysis.result: 若 PSR J0901-4046 为孤立强磁化白矮星（B-WD），其表面磁场仅需 $B_s \sim 6.4\times 10^8 - 3.1\times 10^{10}\text{ G}$（对应磁倾角 $\alpha \approx 2^\circ - 8^\circ$），能自然规避量子临界磁场 $B_{\rm crit} \approx 4.414\times 10^{13}\text{ G}$ 的抑制；白矮星转动能损率可充足支持射电辐射（如长周期源 GLEAM-X J162759.5-523504.3 达 $\dot{E}_{\rm rot} \gtrsim 10^{33}\text{ erg s}^{-1}$），且整星紫外光度 $L_{\rm UV} \lesssim 10^{30}\text{ erg s}^{-1}$，符合未探测到 X/UV 高能辐射的观测现状。

analysis.title_zh: 中微子混合的重整化群跑动是不可探测的
analysis.reason: 针对近期文献声称高能中微子探测与天体物理中微子味比会随相互作用动量转移 $Q$ 发生重整化群跑动的假说，本文从场论在壳重整化角度给出了关键理论限制，证明中微子混合由质壳（$p^2 = m_i^2$）自能决定的常数矩阵 $\hat{U}$ 给出，所谓动量依赖源于不自洽截断，为高能天体中微子味比与振荡唯象学提供了重要理论约束。
analysis.result: 证明中微子外线处于质壳（$p^2 = m_i^2$），若强行设定 $\mu = Q$，外腿自能中出现的对数项 $\propto \ln(Q^2/M_X^2)$ 会通过简并放大效应精确抵消质量矩阵从 $M_X$ 到 $Q$ 的跑动，使物理混合矩阵退回为唯一的壳上矩阵 $\hat{U}$；顶点修正无简并放大且受圈因子抑制（SM 中非对角项受 GIM 机制压低至 $\sim 10^{-27}$）；零基线实验已给出严格限制（如跑动参数 $|\beta_{12}|, |\beta_{13}| \lesssim 0.006$--$0.008$），高能天体物理中微子到达地球的味比严格由固定混合矩阵 $\hat{U}$ 决定。
analysis.problem: 解决近期文献中关于“中微子混合矩阵随相互作用动量转移 $Q$ 跑动并在产生/探测实验中可测（如预言零基线味转变及高能天体中微子味比偏离）”的理论假说是否物理自洽、是否可观测的核心争议。
analysis.method: 采用单圈量子场论在壳重整化方案，严格区分重整化标度 $\mu$、动量转移 $Q$ 与外线动量平方 $p^2 = m_i^2$；结合夸克 CKM 矩阵类比，推导弱电荷流相互作用拉氏量 $-\mathcal{L}_{\rm CC} = \frac{g}{\sqrt{2}} \overline{\ell_\alpha} \gamma^\mu P_L U_{\alpha i}(\mu) \nu_i W_\mu^- + \mathrm{h.c.}$ 在包含外线上壳自能修正 $\Sigma(p^2)$ 下的完整跃迁振幅；并在跷跷板（Seesaw）、MSSM 与 SMEFT 等模型中检验常数跑动参数化 $dX/d\ln|Q^2| = \beta_X$ 的场论效应。
assumptions: 中微子在宏观距离上传播，各个质量本征态在外线处于质壳（$p^2 = m_i^2$）
limits: 结论适用于标准模型及其常见轻子数破缺扩展（如 Seesaw、MSSM、SMEFT），未排除真正在微观顶角引入树图级或非微扰大味改变的新相互作用（NSI）

analysis.title_zh: 基于 Planck 低 ell EE 极化与莱曼系谱线森林对宇宙再电离历史的联合限制
analysis.reason: 该工作聚焦于利用 Planck CMB 极化数据与高红移类星体 Lyman-series 森林对宇宙再电离历史（$z_{50}$、$\Delta z_{90}$、$\tau_{\rm es}$）进行大尺度宇宙学贝叶斯联合推断，不涉及 FRB/PRS 及其环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、相对论喷流或致密天体高能瞬变观测等研究组核心方向。
analysis.result: 联合 CMB 极化与莱曼森林（暗像元 DP 与阻尼翼类 DWlike）测量后，三参数 Weibull 宇宙再电离模型给出再电离中点红移 $z_{50} = 7.5^{+0.5}_{-0.9}$，再电离持续时间 95% 置信上限为 $\Delta z_{90} < 11.5$；非参数化 \textsc{FlexKnot} 模型给出 $z_{50} = 7.7^{+0.7}_{-0.8}$ 与 $\Delta z_{90} < 11.4$。电子散射总光学深度稳定在 $\tau_{\rm es} \approx 0.061$，且极早期再电离贡献被严格限制为 $\tau_{\rm es}^{z>15} < 0.0039\sim 0.0058$。引入氢光致电离率 $\Gamma_{\rm HI}$ 进一步锁定中点红移至 $z_{50} = 7.4^{+0.2}_{-0.3}$、$\Delta z_{90} = 6.0^{+0.8}_{-1.0}$，并指示共动电离发射率在 $z \sim 7\text{--}8$ 达到峰值后随红移降低而下降。
analysis.problem: 单纯依赖 CMB 低 $\ell$ EE 极化仅能限制视线方向积分的电子散射光学深度 $\tau_{\rm es}$，在单独拟合时再电离中点红移与持续时间存在严重简并；而 Ly$\alpha$ 森林测量对再电离末期红移（$z \sim 5\text{--}6$）的中性氢丰度高度敏感，需探究二者联合如何打破参数简并并约束电离发射率物理演化。
analysis.method: 基于 Cobaya 框架与修改版 CAMB，联合 Planck PR4 LoLLiPoP（低 $\ell$ EE）、PR3 Commander（低 $\ell$ TT）与 Plik_lite（高 $\ell$ TTTEEE）似然；结合类星体暗像元体积分数上限、阻尼翼中性度下限（$z=5.8$ 处 $\langle x_{\rm HI}\rangle_V \gtrsim 0.061$）及 $\Gamma_{\rm HI}$ 透射率演化；采用半解析辐射转移模型，光子平均自由程表示为 $\lambda^{-1} = \lambda_n^{-1} + \lambda_i^{-1}$（其中 $\lambda_n(x_{\rm HII}) = A \frac{e^{B x_{\rm HII}}}{1-x_{\rm HII}}$，$\lambda_i \propto \Gamma_{\rm HI}^{2/3}$），电离发射率采用双幂律模型 $\dot{n}_{\rm ion}(z) = N_* / [((1+z)/(1+z_*))^{-\alpha_*} + ((1+z)/(1+z_*))^{-\beta_*}]$ 展开 MCMC 贝叶斯推断。
assumptions: 基准分析假设星系际介质中氢的质量加权电离度近似等于体积加权电离度（$\langle x_{\rm HII} \rangle_{\rm M} \approx \langle x_{\rm HII} \rangle_{\rm V}$），附录检验显示辐射转移转化效应引起的偏差极小。

analysis.title_zh: 能否通过千新星光变曲线约束双中子星并合时刻
analysis.reason: 文章系统量化了利用多波段千新星（KN）测光反演双中子星（BNS）并合时刻 $t_0$ 的精度与物理限制。这直接服务于无引力波（GW）触发或孤立千新星的光学后随巡天及引力波次阈值回溯搜索，切合研究组致密天体高能观测与电磁对应体物理兴趣。
analysis.result: 在 Rubin/LSST 巡天节奏下，仅靠千新星光变反演并合时刻 $t_0$ 的 $90\%$ 置信区间宽度中位数为 $5.49\,\mathrm{days}$；若在并合前 $3\,\mathrm{h}$ 引入两个相邻滤光片的测光上限，后验宽度可收缩约 $60\%$；红移先验（固定 $D_L$）带来的改善 $<5\%$。在 AT2017gfo 测光结合单点合成上升期观测的最优场景下，$t_0$ 估计不确定度可压缩至 $0.03\,\mathrm{days}$（$0.72\,\mathrm{hours}$）。对于余辉扣除后的 GRB-KN 样本（如 GRB 211211A），$1\sigma$ 精度可达 $8.7\,\mathrm{hours}$；若首个探测晚于并合 $\gtrsim 4\,\mathrm{days}$（如 GRB 060614），后验弥散则宽达 $>120\,\mathrm{hours}$。
analysis.problem: 光学望远镜（如 LSST）首次探测到千新星通常明显晚于并合发生时刻，如何在缺少 GW 预警或探测存在时滞的情况下，仅依赖千新星光变曲线及测光上限精确限定 BNS 并合时刻 $t_0$ 并压窄后随时间窗口。
analysis.method: 结合四类参数推断框架（\textsc{nmma}、\textsc{Redback}、\textsc{nessai/bilby}、\textsc{rift}）和多套数值/半解析辐射转移网格（如 \texttt{Bu2026_MLP}、\texttt{Bu2019lm}、\texttt{Ka2017}、\texttt{Brethauer26}、\texttt{LANL}），对抛射物质量 $M_{\rm ej}$、速度 $v_{\rm ej}$、不透明度 $\kappa$ 及系统误差 $\sigma_{\rm sys}$ 与时移参量 $t_0$ 进行贝叶斯后验采样，计算群体合并后验 $P(\theta | t_{0,\mathrm{true}}) = \frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{LC}}} \sum_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{LC}}} P(\theta|\mathrm{LC}_i,t_{0,\mathrm{true}})$。
assumptions: 假设千新星辐射主要由 $r$-过程核衰变（可叠加星风、动力学成分或激波冷却茧状物）主导，部分模型假设各向同性或轴对称几何。
真实事件 AT2017gfo 分析中默认固定宿主星系光度距离 $D_L = 40.7\,\mathrm{Mpc}$。
limits: 若缺乏上升阶段的早期测光探测点或高置信度测光上限，稀疏巡天采样的并合时刻反演误差可达数天以上（$90\%$ 区间达 $5.5\,\mathrm{days}$）。

analysis.title_zh: 脉冲星风云 CTB 87 的全面 X 射线特性研究：来自 X 射线与宽波段辐射的反向激波相互作用证据
analysis.reason: 该工作结合 Chandra、XMM-Newton 与 NuSTAR 对脉冲星风云 CTB 87 进行了高精度 X 射线空间分辨与能谱分析，揭示了强同步冷却及内在谱曲率，并结合演化单区与多区模型探讨了反向激波压缩对粒子布居与宽波段辐射的深刻影响，为研究脉冲星风与超新星遗迹相互作用环境提供了典型观测约束与模型对比。
analysis.result: X 射线表面亮度剖面在 1--5 keV 与 5--10 keV 下的指数衰减尺度分别为 $l = 45''.0\pm1''.0$ 与 $36''.4\pm2''.3$（呈 $3.4\sigma$ 显著差异），证实尺寸随能量增大而收缩的同步辐射冷却特征。全区积分谱排斥单幂律，折断幂律（BPL，$E_{\rm b} = 5.12\pm0.26\,\mathrm{keV}$，$\Gamma_1 = 1.89\pm0.05$，$\Gamma_2 = 2.73\pm0.10$）与指数截止幂律（CPL，$\Gamma = 1.23\pm0.10$，$E_{\rm c} = 5.29\pm0.67\,\mathrm{keV}$）拟合显著更优。演化单区模型显示反向激波在 $t \sim 4.7\,\mathrm{kyr}$ 时压缩星云使磁场增至 $B \sim 50\,\mu\mathrm{G}$，但稳态多区与单区模型均表明必须存在演化效应或多电子成分才能兼顾 X 射线弯折与 $\lesssim 1\,\mathrm{TeV}$ 处的伽马射线过剩。
analysis.problem: CTB 87 呈现狭窄且显著弯曲的 X 射线能谱，与宽广复杂的伽马射线 SED（尤其是 $\sim 0.1\text{--}1\,\mathrm{TeV}$ 的反常通量隆起）难以用单一稳态电子加速与均匀冷却图景自洽解释，且反向激波相互作用对粒子空间传输与能谱硬度的具体改造机制尚存争议。
analysis.method: 利用 Chandra、XMM-Newton 和 NuSTAR 0.5--20 keV 联合数据进行空间分辨能谱与环带形态分析；采用基于自转能损 $\dot{E}_{\rm SD}(t)=\dot{E}_{\rm SD}(0)(1+t/\tau_0)^{-\frac{n+1}{n-1}}$ 的演化单区模型模拟 PWN 与 SNR/ISM 的流体动力学演化；构建包含径向流速 $V_{\rm flow}(r) \propto r^{\alpha_V}$ 与能量依赖扩散系数 $D(r,E_e) \propto B(r)^{-1} E_e^{1/3}$ 的球对称稳态多区粒子传输与辐射模型。

analysis.title_zh: 利用 XPoSat 探测 MAXI J1750-327 首次爆发期间的准周期振荡与谱-时演化：对黑洞质量与自旋的约束
analysis.reason: 该工作利用印度 XPoSat 卫星的 XSPECT 载荷，对黑洞双星瞬变源 MAXI J1750-327 首次爆发进行了谱-时联合观测，捕捉到了 Type-C 到 Type-B QPO 的演化以及截断盘向 ISCO 移动的物理过程，并基于全局 Lense-Thirring (LT) 进动模型给出了黑洞质量和自旋的定量限制，属于致密天体高能吸积与进动物理的典型观测样本研究。
analysis.result: 观测证实 MAXI J1750-327 在爆发初期经历快速硬到软态转变，内盘温度由 $T_{\rm in} = 0.43\pm0.04\text{ keV}$ 升至 $0.92\text{--}1.01\text{ keV}$，光子指数由 $\Gamma = 2.03\pm0.02$ 变陡至 $2.93^{+0.22}_{-0.23}$。基频 QPO 频率由历元 1 的 $\nu_{\rm QPO} = 1.75\pm0.05\text{ Hz}$ 单调漂移至历元 4 的 $8.77\pm0.22\text{ Hz}$，分数 rms 振幅由 $9.1\%$ 降至 $6.8\%$（由 Type-C 向 Type-B 转变并在软态猝灭）。结合全局 Lense-Thirring 进动标度（$\nu \propto r_{\rm in}^{-3}$）与吸积盘截断半径 $R_{{\rm o},j} = \xi f_{\rm col}^2 D_{10} (N_{{\rm diskbb},j}/\cos i)^{1/2}\text{ km}$，在贝叶斯推断下测定黑洞质量为 $M_{\rm BH} = 7.92^{+6.19}_{-3.72}\,M_{\odot}$，无量纲自旋为 $a_* = 0.163^{+0.116}_{-0.056}$。
analysis.problem: 利用 X 射线双星爆发态演化期间准周期振荡（QPO）与吸积盘几何演化的关联，检验截断盘全局 Lense-Thirring 进动模型，并独立打破黑洞质量、距离、倾角与自旋参量间的测量简并。
analysis.method: 利用 XPoSat/XSPECT（0.8–11.0 keV）能段数据构建功率密度谱（PDS）并采用洛伦兹轮廓与幂律噪声（$A\nu^{-\alpha}$）拟合低频 QPO；能谱采用 `TBabs*(nthComp + gaussian + diskbb)` 模型进行分解；在假定吸积流内边界位于 Kerr ISCO（$R_{\rm i} = r_{\rm ISCO}(a_*) R_g$）并由 diskbb 归一化确定外截断半径的前提下，基于 scrambled Sobol 准蒙特卡洛对距离 $D$、倾角 $i$ 等干扰参数进行边缘化贝叶斯拟合。
limits: 黑洞质量的不确定度范围较大（$M_{\rm BH} = 7.92^{+6.19}_{-3.72}\,M_\odot$），源于 $M_{\rm BH}$、双星距离、轨道倾角与 diskbb 物理有效半径之间的内在参量简并。

analysis.title_zh: 倾斜吸积盘与热日冕的 Kerr 黑洞吸积系统中的 X 射线康普顿化：广义相对论蒙特卡罗模拟 II. 偏振特征
analysis.reason: 该工作建立了包含 Kerr 黑洞强引力光线弯曲、Walker-Penrose 偏振平行输运、热日冕偏振康普顿散射和倾斜外吸积盘偏振反射的完整广义相对论蒙特卡罗（GRMC）偏振辐射转移模型，定量揭示了致密天体强引力弯折（增加 DOP）与多次散射/外盘发射稀释（抑制 DOP 及其进动调制）之间的竞争机制，对理解致密天体吸积系统（如黑洞 X 射线双星硬态高偏振度及 QPO 偏振调制缺失）具有重要理论和模拟价值。
analysis.result: 研究发现 X 射线偏振信号由相互竞争的几何与辐射过程主导：(1) 在无散射极限下，Kerr 时空引力弯折捕获了强偏折且去偏振的光子，使 DOP 拟合振幅从平直时空的 $A=11.02\pm0.64\%$ 升至 $A=14.30\pm0.71\%$；光子发射半径从 $R_0=9.5\,R_{\rm g}$ 缩至 $4.5\,R_{\rm g}$ 时振幅从 $8.84\%$ 升至 $11.02\%$。(2) 日冕多次康普顿散射与外盘反射起去偏振作用，外盘反照率 $\rho_{\rm alb}$ 从 $0.15$ 增至 $0.95$ 时振幅降至 $6.34\pm0.57\%$；进动 DOP 调制幅度从 $1.007\%$ 降至 $0.548\%$。(3) 内外盘联合系统中，外盘稳态辐射显著稀释内盘进动效应，使全盘总 DOP 仅在狭窄范围（$\sim 2.8\%$）微弱波动（调制幅度仅约 $0.09\%$，AOP 摆动仅约 $0.3^\circ$），成功解释了为何 IXPE 未能在 Swift J1727.8-1613 等源中测出显著的 QPO 偏振调制。
analysis.problem: IXPE 观测揭示了现有模型难以解释的矛盾：一方面在黑洞双星 Swift J1727.8-1613 中未探测到相对论进动模型（RPM）预期的 QPO 偏振度与偏振角调制；另一方面在弱射流硬态黑洞 IGR J17091-3624 中却测出高达约 $9\%$ 的反常高偏振度。亟需一个自洽耦合 Kerr 时空弯曲、倾斜盘进动、日冕康普顿散射与外盘反射的完整偏振辐射转移框架。
analysis.method: 扩展 Paper I 的 GRMC 辐射转移引擎：(1) 内盘初始偏振遵循 Chandrasekhar 电子散射大气公式：$\mathrm{DOP}=\mathrm{DOP}_{\rm init}(1-\mu)/(1+3.582\mu)$（$\mathrm{DOP}_{\rm init}=0.1171$）；(2) 沿 Kerr 零测地线偏振矢量演化采用复 Walker--Penrose 守恒常数 $\kappa_{\rm WP}=K_1+iK_2$（满足 $\mathrm{d}\kappa_{\rm WP}/\mathrm{d}\lambda=0$）求解；(3) 日冕热电子康普顿散射在电子静止系中计算并经 Lorentz 变换重投影偏振态；(4) 计算倾斜外吸积盘对冠区光子的偏振反射，并结合外盘直接多温黑体发射合成全系统 Stokes 参数。
assumptions: 吸积盘被近似为具有内部截断的几何平直但空间倾斜的内外双区结构（内盘进动，外盘稳态）。
citation_leads: Introduction: “Here we extend the transport engine of Paper~I to track the full photon polarization state, adding a Walker--Penrose parallel-transport formalism and a polarized treatment of Compton and disc scattering.”
Polarized Radiative Transfer: “Along a null geodesic the polarization vector is parallel transported. Rather than integrating the transport equation, we use the Walker--Penrose constant”

Results: X-ray Polarization: “The inner and outer discs are tilted away from the BH spin axis (the $Z$ axis) by $\theta_{\rm in}=10^{\circ}$ and $\theta_{\rm out}=40^{\circ}$ respectively, with both tilts lying in the $Y$--$Z$ plane. The outer disc spans the radial”

Results: X-ray Polarization: “The enhancement is therefore not a consequence of scattering. It is a purely geometric effect of the BH removing the most strongly bent, and hence most depolarized, photon paths from the observed ensemble.”

Results: X-ray Polarization: “The extent to which the outer-disc contribution dilutes that of the inner disc depends on the relative photon-weighted contributions of the two regions, which in turn depend on the size and location of the inner disc's photon-emitting”

Conclusions: “The outer disc's constant polarization state dilutes the precession-driven modulation of the inner disc, narrowing the net observable range of DOP and AOP swept out over a precession cycle.”

analysis.reason: 该工作利用 HAWC 对银道面拥挤天区的中年脉冲星 PSR J1928+1746 进行高精度空间与能谱解构，确认了覆盖 2 TeV 至 >100 TeV 的延展超额 HAWC J1928+1750，为致密天体高能观测及脉冲星周围 TeV 晕的粒子扩散抑制提供了重要实测约束。
analysis.result: 检测显著性达 $\sim 17\sigma$，内禀角延展为高斯宽度 $\sigma = 0.19^\circ \pm 0.02^\circ$（物理尺度 $R_{68} \simeq 22\text{ pc}$）。在参考能量 $E_0 = 12\text{ TeV}$ 处，对数抛物线拟合谱指数 $\alpha = 2.09 \pm 0.11$、曲率 $\beta = 0.35 \pm 0.08$、通量归一化 $K = (5.0 \pm 0.5) \times 10^{-15}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}\text{ TeV}^{-1}$。在轻子扩散模型下，采用标度律 $D(E_e) = D_0 (1 + E_e / 3\text{ GeV})^{1/3}$ 拟合得到 $D(100\text{ TeV}) \simeq 2.1 \times 10^{27}\text{ cm}^2\text{ s}^{-1}$（比 ISM 抑制约 500 倍）；单区轻子逆康普顿模型给出电子截止能量 $E_{{\rm cut},e} = 87^{+73}_{-28}\text{ TeV}$，能量需求 $W_e(E_e>1\text{ TeV}) \simeq 3.3 \times 10^{46}\text{ erg}$，仅占自转减速能 $E_{\rm sd} \simeq 4.1 \times 10^{48}\text{ erg}$ 的 $<1\%$，电子能量密度 $\epsilon_e \sim 2\times 10^{-2}\text{ eV cm}^{-3}$，完全符合 TeV 晕特征。
analysis.problem: PSR J1928+1746 处于银道面复杂拥挤区域（与 3HWC J1928+178、Fermi-LAT 延展源以及 LHAASO 源混叠），且缺乏清晰的 X 射线同步辐射对应体，亟需在超高能伽马射线波段精确分离点源与弥散成分，厘清该超额是演化脉冲星风云/TeV 晕的轻子辐射还是与分子云碰撞的强子辐射。
analysis.method: 利用 HAWC 历时 2904 天的数据，结合 3ML 与 HAL 进行泊松似然分析；在固定 HERMES 银河弥散模型（基准 $k_{\rm GDE} = 1$）的前提下，通过 $\mathrm{TS} > 25$ 的迭代寻源构建 6 成分全局空间源模型；利用 EDGE 扩散模板以及 Naima 辐射模型对能谱展开轻子逆康普顿与强子 $\pi^0$ 衰变唯象拟合。
citation_leads: HAWC Data Set and Event Selection: “We use 2904 days of HAWC data between June 2015 and January 2024.”

Global Source Model of the Region: “The global source model obtained from the iterative source-finding procedure consists of the fixed HERMES diffuse component, with $k_{\rm GDE}=1$, and six source components within the region of interest.”
The TeV-Halo Candidate near PSR~J1928+1746: “The HAWC-sensitive energy range of HAWC~J1928+1750 extends from about 2~TeV up to energies exceeding 100~TeV”

Scenarios for Gamma-Ray Production: “The lack of a clear X-ray counterpart is consistent with an evolved PWN or TeV halo, where the synchrotron nebula may be faint, but IC emission is still detectable at TeV energies”
analysis.research_progress: 将该天区能谱测量拓宽至 $>100\text{ TeV}$，不仅验证了与 LHAASO 结果的一致性，还通过测量能谱高能曲率与极低的电子能量密度，实测给出了高达 500 倍的局部介质粒子扩散抑制（$D(100\text{ TeV}) \simeq 2.1 \times 10^{27}\text{ cm}^2\text{ s}^{-1}$），有力确立了其作为典型低能量密度 TeV 晕的地位。

analysis.title_zh: NGC 3227的“眨眼”现象：塞弗特星系中的极端变脸事件
analysis.reason: 本工作聚焦于塞弗特星系 NGC 3227 的光学变脸（changing-look AGN）现象、宽发射线区（BLR）混响映射与核区遮挡体物理，属于传统活动星系核物理研究，与本研究组重点关注的 FRB/PRS、超新星中心引擎与激波破越/CSM 相互作用、相对论喷流及致密天体高能瞬变方向无实质联系。
analysis.result: 观测表明 NGC 3227 在数周内 5100~\AA\ 连续谱减弱约 70%，宽 H$\beta$ 通量减弱约 80%；在遮挡相期间，连续谱与宽 H$\beta$ 之间测得显著的时间延迟（ICCF 给出 $\tau = 6.13^{+1.44}_{-0.99}\,\mathrm{days}$，MICA 给出 $\tau = 7.72^{+2.09}_{-2.10}\,\mathrm{days}$），排除了遮挡体位于 BLR 外部的假说。Photoionization 计算与 Thomson 散射透射率公式 $T = \exp(-1.17\,N_{\rm H}\,\sigma_{\rm T})$ 表明，衰减需要位于 BLR 内部的全电离康普顿厚柱密度 $N_{\rm H} \simeq 1.5\times10^{24}\,\mathrm{cm^{-2}}$。
analysis.problem: 传统光学变脸（CLAGN）事件多被归因于内禀吸积率的剧变，探究纯遮挡效应是否能够驱动大幅度光学连续谱变暗与宽发射线消失，并利用时间延迟定标遮挡体相对于宽发射线区（BLR）的空间几何位置。
analysis.method: 利用怀俄明红外天文台（WIRO）长缝光谱监测与 ZTF $g$ 模测光，采用 [O~\textsc{iii}]~$\lambda5007$ 窄发射线进行内禀流量定标并扣除宿主星系成分；使用阻尼随机游走（DRW）进行 100,000 次模拟检验排除随机吸积涨落零假设（$p = 0.002$）；运用 ICCF 与 MICA 进行反响映射时延分析；利用 \texttt{Cloudy} C25 进行平面对称气流光电离网格计算。
assumptions: 窄线 H$\beta$ 通量与发射轮廓在整个监测期间保持恒定，且 [O III] $\lambda5007$ 在年际尺度上保持稳定
limits: X 射线观测在光学最暗时刻之前已结束且采样稀疏，且 X 射线推导的吸收柱密度比光学电子散射模型低 1 到 2 个数量级
现有观测数据尚无法确定遮挡体的确切几何与动力学本质（如吸积盘风还是其他环核结构）
citation_leads: Introduction: “Changing-look active galactic nuclei (CLAGNs) are AGNs that exhibit dramatic changes in their spectral characteristics”
Reverberation lags: “gives a lag of {$6.13^{+1.44}_{-0.99}$~days}, while MICA yields a broader posterior at $7.72^{+2.09}_{-2.10}$~days.”

Photoionization modeling of the obscurer: “requires a Compton-thick column density of $N_{\rm H} \simeq 1.5\times10^{24}$~cm$^{-2}$.”

analysis.title_zh: 超新星星风激波破越中的双激波辐射与EP260321a
analysis.reason: 文章系统构建了超新星（SN）抛射物与光学厚致密周星介质（CSM）相互作用的双激波（前向激波 FS 与反向激波 RS）辐射介导激波破越（SBO）模型，并成功应用于解释爱因斯坦探针（EP）新近探测到的软 X 射线暂现源 EP260321a，高度契合本组关于激波破越、周星介质相互作用及早期高能瞬变源观测的研究方向。
analysis.result: 推导了双激波结构中内能比 $E_3 = \mu E_2$ 与特征速度比 $\bar{v}_r = \mu v_f$（其中 $\mu = (\delta+2)^{-1} \simeq 1/7$），阐明正激波 $v_{f,bo} \sim 0.5c$ 处于非局部热平衡（non-LTE）而低速反激波 $\bar{v}_{r,bo} \sim 0.07c$ 满足 LTE 并主导黑体热辐射。测定破越半径 $r_{bo} \simeq 5\times 10^{12}\,\mathrm{cm} \gg R_\star$，确认星风需在 $r_w \sim 10^{13}\,\mathrm{cm}$ 处截断且散射介质壳层质量约为 $M_m \sim 10^{-3} \tau_m\,M_\odot$。
analysis.problem: 传统超新星星风破越模型常忽略反向激波或简并处理辐射热力学平衡，难以合理解释 EP260321a 表现出的超高光度、快上升慢衰减的 X 射线软能谱演化以及与早期光学辐射之间的时延矛盾。
analysis.method: 结合辐射流体动力学 Rankine-Hugoniot 跳跃条件与接触间断面压强平衡构建双激波解析动力学；利用 Monte Carlo（MC）模拟光子在有限厚度球壳介质中的扩散传输；结合未扫过 C/O 包层冷却（cooling envelope）模型拟合早期多波段光学光变曲线。

analysis.title_zh: 基于平滑跨越物态方程的混合星研究
analysis.reason: 文章构建了从强子到解禁夸克相（CFL模型）的平滑跨越（crossover）物态方程，放弃了传统的 Maxwell 压力平衡要求，给出了相变交叉化学势的指数标度律，并计算了混合星最大质量及潮汐形变度 $\Lambda$。该结果为超新星中心引擎致密残骸的相变软化、大质量中子星支撑以及双中子星并合引力波（如 GW170817）观测提供了核物理与致密天体微观物理约束。
analysis.result: 研究发现平滑跨越导致物态方程相较纯强子相变软，降低了中子星最大质量；但当有效袋常数满足 $B_{\rm eff} \ge 180\;{\rm MeV}$ 时，最大质量仍可支撑超过 $2\,M_\odot$ 的天文观测下限。在过渡区，声速平方 $c_s^2$ 产生峰值并随 $B_{\rm eff}$ 增大而更尖锐，高密度下渐近趋于共形极限 $1/3$。对于给定的夸克模型，相变交叉化学势 $\mu_{\rm cros}$ 随着强子物态刚度参数 $\eta$ 的增加而指数减小，且得到的无量纲潮汐形变度 $\Lambda$ 与 GW170817 观测限制高度吻合。
analysis.problem: 传统核物质到夸克物质的相变常基于 Maxwell 或 Gibbs 构造（强制要求两相压力相等），但在超高密度强耦合区域，强子到解禁夸克物质更可能以平滑过渡（crossover）形式发生。如何建立热力学自洽的连续切换物态方程并检验其对 $2\,M_\odot$ 脉冲星质量和潮汐形变 $\Lambda$ 的影响，是致密星物理中的核心问题。
analysis.method: 强子相采用饱和密度 $n_0 = 0.16\;{\rm fm}^{-3}$ 展开模型，受刚度参数 $\eta = (K_0 L^2)^{1/3}$ 调控；夸克相采用色味锁闭（CFL）模型 $P_q(\mu) = \frac{3}{4\pi^2}a_4\left(\frac{\mu}{3}\right)^4 + \frac{3}{\pi^2}\Delta^2\left(\frac{\mu}{3}\right)^2 - B_{\rm eff}$。通过无量纲切换函数实现平滑跨越（要求 $6 \le r \le 9$ 且 $\mu_0 = \mu_{\rm cros} \pm 100\;{\rm MeV}$），并联立求解 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff (TOV) 方程与潮汐扰动方程计算 $M$-$R$ 关系及潮汐形变度 $\Lambda = \frac{2}{3}k_2 \left(\frac{c^2 R}{GM}\right)^5$。
citation_leads: Crossover Equation of State: “By adopting the crossover EoS approach, the requirement of pressure equality between the hadronic and quark phases, which is characteristic of the Maxwell construction for a phase transition, is abandoned.”
Neutron star structure: “The bulk properties of neutron stars, such as mass, radius and tidal deformability are determined by solving the coupled TOV  equations”

Results and Discussion: “For purely hadronic matter, the squared speed of sound asymptotically approaches unity. The squared speed of sound in the crossover EoS follows the same trend as long as hadronic matter dominates.”
analysis.research_progress: 建立了由核参数 $\eta = (K_0 L^2)^{1/3}$ 控制的相变交叉化学势经验标度律 $\mu_{\rm cros} = p_1 \exp[-p_2 \eta] + p_3$；约束了使渐近夸克行为物理自洽的切换函数参数区间；证实了混合星模型能在满足 $M_{\rm max} > 2\,M_\odot$ 及 GW170817 潮汐形变约束的同时，容纳类似 HESS J1731-347 的低质量致密天体解。

analysis.title_zh: 快速自转中子星中 r 模非线性演化的完全广义相对论数值模拟
analysis.reason: 该工作首次在摒弃 Cowling 近似和后牛顿近似的完全广义相对论时空-流体自洽演化框架下，模拟了快速自转中子星（$f_{\rm spin} \approx 792\,\mathrm{Hz}$）中非线性 $l=|m|=2$ r 模的动力学行为，精确测定了模式频率、非线性频移、引力波应变与非线性三模耦合，为超新星后快速自转致密天体遗迹演化及连续引力波搜寻提供了基准参数约束。
analysis.result: 数值模拟测得 $l=|m|=2$ 的 r 模无量纲频率为 $\kappa = |f_{\text{r-mode}}/f_{\rm spin,eq} - 2| \approx 0.7197$（对应 $f_{\text{r-mode}} \approx 1014\,\mathrm{Hz}$），比牛顿值 $\kappa_{\rm N} = 2/3$ 高约 $8\%$，该偏差由相对论红移/参考系拖拽造成的频降 $\Delta\kappa_{\rm GR} = -0.0860$ 与离心形变造成的频升 $\Delta\kappa_{\rm spin} = 0.1510$ 共同抵消决定。随着振幅 $\tilde{\alpha}$ 增大，频率展现二次非线性依赖关系：$\kappa(\tilde{\alpha}) = 0.720 - 4.09\times 10^{-3}\tilde{\alpha} - 1.56\times 10^{-2}\tilde{\alpha}^2$（或 $f_{\text{r-mode}} \approx 1014 + 0.044\tilde{\alpha} + 6.8\tilde{\alpha}^2\,\mathrm{Hz}$）。在 $10\,\mathrm{kpc}$ 处测得的引力波特征应变为 $h_{\text{r-mode}} \approx 9.7 \times 10^{-22}$，比线性四极矩公式估算高约 $35\%$。此外，在四极与径向伴生模式处测得引力波辐射振幅服从 $\propto \alpha_0^2$ 的标度律，提供了两列 r 模与轴对称模式发生三模非线性耦合（three-mode coupling）的直接证据。
analysis.problem: 快速自转中子星中的 r 模不稳定性是非轴对称流体振荡与引力波辐射（CFS 机制）的关键来源，但以往模拟多局限于牛顿引力或 Cowling 近似（固定背景度规），无法自洽包含时空动态扰动、自感应较差自转反馈以及真实的模式-时空非线性耦合效应，致使引力波频率与振幅定标存在系统偏差。
analysis.method: 利用 Einstein Toolkit 求解完全广义相对论流体动力学体系：采用 `McLachlan` 演化 CCZ4 形式的时空度规（配合 1+log 切片与 Gamma-driver 规范），采用 `GRHydro` 结合增强型 PPM 重构与 HLLE 黎曼求解器演化 Valencia 形式的理想相对论流体方程。构建快速自转（$\Omega_{\rm eq}/\Omega_{\rm K} \approx 0.93$）、多方指数 $n_{\rm poly}=1$ 的平衡星模型 BU6（$M=1.627\,M_\odot$），施加初态 $l=|m|=2$ 的磁型矢量球谐三速度微扰 $\delta\boldsymbol{v}$（无量纲初幅 $0.2 \le \alpha_0 \le 1.2$），通过质量流多极矩 $J_{22}(t)$ 与 Newman-Penrose 标量 $\psi_4$ 提取流体本征模及引力波波形。
assumptions: 中子星采用单组分无磁场、无耗散的理想流体模型，物态方程简化为等熵多方形式（$n_{\mathrm{poly}}=1$ 且 $\Gamma_1=\Gamma$ 恒定）。
初始平衡星为均匀快速自转状态（BU6 模型，$\Omega_{\mathrm{eq}}/\Omega_{\mathrm{K}} \approx 0.93$）。

analysis.reason: 该工作结合LIGO/Virgo第三次观测运行（O3）以及地中海中微子望远镜ANTARES和KM3NeT/ORCA6的数据，针对高能瞬变源（如BNS、NSBH、相对论喷流及核坍缩超新星）开展了GW-HEN触发与阈下多信使联合证认，给出了辐射能量与源率密度的严格上限，与本组关于致密天体多信使高能观测和相对论喷流研究密切相关。
analysis.result: 两项互补搜索（未建模触发搜索与阈下贝叶斯联合搜索）均未发现显著GW-HEN共源信号（最高关联事例 $\mathrm{IFAR} \lesssim 0.8\,\mathrm{yr}$）。对共同可探测源发生率密度给出 90% 置信度上限：基于阈下搜索，对于假定引力波能量 $E_{\mathrm{GW}} = 10^{-2}\,M_\odot c^2$ 与中微子各向同性能量 $E_{\mathrm{iso},\nu} = 10^{51}\,\mathrm{erg}$ 的瞬变源，其源率密度上限被约束为 $R_{\mathrm{UL}} < 4 \times 10^3\,\mathrm{Gpc^{-3}\,yr^{-1}}$；触发搜索排除了 SGC 与 ADI 模型在 $< 200\,\mathrm{Mpc}$ 内的辐射源。
analysis.problem: 双致密星（BNS/NSBH）并合、相对论喷流强子相互作用（$p\gamma$、$pp$）以及核坍缩超新星（CCSNe）理论上预言共同辐射引力波与高能中微子，但在地下与水下探测中存在大量仪器噪声及大气中微子背景，亟需评估在现有探测灵敏度下是否存在统计显著的时空重叠瞬变候选体，并限制天体物理源群的发生率密度。

analysis.title_zh: 中子星–主序星碰撞：索恩–热特科夫天体（TŻO）的形成与长期演化
analysis.reason: 本文揭示了新生中子星与主序伴星直接碰撞形成索恩–热特科夫天体（TŻO）的自洽动力学演化及长期宿命，证实其晚期具有极强超爱丁顿脉动不稳定性，并可能伴随剧烈爆发抛射或黑洞喷流破越，为高能瞬变源与致密天体演化提供了动力学机制参考。
analysis.result: TŻO 的形成与长期演化经历三个主要阶段：(1) 热弛豫阶段（时标 $\tau_{\rm th} \approx \xi \frac{G(M_{\ast}+M_{\rm NS})^2}{R_{\ast}} \frac{1}{L_{\rm acc}} \approx 2 \times 10^3\,{\rm yr}$），动力学激波与吸积驱动核温度升至 $T_{\rm core} \approx 3.3 \times 10^8\,{\rm K}$，爆发性 CNO 循环填补了经典模型在 $8\text{--}14\,M_\odot$ 的间隙；(2) 标准 TŻO 阶段（持续约 $10^7\,{\rm yr}$），恒星处于热平衡，半径膨胀至 $R \sim 10^3\,R_\odot$，光度稳定在 $L \approx 6.3 \times 10^4\,L_\odot$；(3) 黑洞增长阶段（持续约 $10^8\,{\rm yr}$），NS 塌缩为 BH。演化终局包层高度超爱丁顿，爱丁顿因子峰值达到 $\Gamma_{\rm Edd} \simeq 55$，并激发生长模（复频率 $\omega \simeq 0.741 + 0.115i$，增长时标 $\sim 10\,{\rm yr}$）的非绝热脉动不稳定性，驱动类似 LBV 的剧烈质量抛射。
analysis.problem: 经典索恩–热特科夫天体（TŻO）理论通常直接预设系统已处于静力与热平衡状态，缺乏从新生致密天体与伴星的真实 3D 动力学合并碰撞到长期 1D 恒星演化的自洽衔接，且经典模型在 $8\text{--}14\,M_\odot$ 质量区间存在无法稳定维持对流包层的空白。
analysis.method: 结合 3D 自适应网格流体动力学模拟（ENZO）与 1D 恒星演化程序（MESA）。在 3D 模拟中将 NS 处理为注入爱丁顿光度热能 $L_{\rm Edd} = 4\pi c G M_{\rm NS}/\kappa \approx 5\times 10^4\,L_\odot$（取 $\kappa=0.34\,{\rm cm^2\,g^{-1}}$）的质点；达到准平衡后依据伯努利常数 $B < 0$ 筛选束缚气体并做球对称投影映射至 MESA；在 1D 演化中引入爱丁顿吸积增重 $\dot{M} = L_{\rm Edd}/(\eta c^2) \approx 2.6\times 10^{-8}\,(M_{\rm core}/M_\odot)(0.1/\eta)\,M_\odot\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$、差分自转及核反应网络，并利用 GYRE 开展非绝热径向脉动不稳定性分析。
limits: MESA 代码在包层强烈超爱丁顿、脱离流体静力学平衡时终止计算，未能完全自洽追踪晚期脉动爆发抛射的完整流体力学动力学过程。
citation_leads: Method: “We take $\kappa=0.34\,\mathrm{cm}^2\, \mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (i.e., $X=0.7$), corresponding to $L_{\mathrm{Edd}}\approx5\times10^4L_\odot$.”
Method: “We evolve the system using 3D hydrodynamics until the NS is well settled at the center of the star and total bound gas mass converges to a nearly constant value”

Result: “The evolution exhibits three major stages having different evolutionary timescales:\n\begin{itemize}\n    \item Thermal relaxation phase: after the dynamical assembly, the resulting \tzo\ is far from  the thermal equilibrium.”
Discussion: “Our stability analysis identifies a growing radial mode, suggesting that these pulsations may become strong enough to unbind and eject the outer layers”
analysis.research_progress: 建立了首个从 3D 流体动力学碰撞完整跨越到长期 1D 恒星演化的自洽 TŻO 模型；揭示了动力学压缩与激波加热可引发显著高于 Eddington 光度的非平衡核聚变，证实了碰撞成因 TŻO 能够稳定跨越经典理论中的 $8\text{--}14\,M_\odot$ 质量断层；明确了晚期包层在超爱丁顿驱动下会发展出时标 $\sim 10\,{\rm yr}$ 的脉动不稳定性导致爆发性质量抛射。

analysis.reason: 该工作利用 FAST 发现并测时监测了迄今偏心率最高（$e = 0.99238692$）的银河系双中子星（DNS）系统 PSR J0653+0443，观测到由于近侧向轨道几何引发的伴星磁层掩食效应，精确测量后开普勒参数并限制了双星质量与非相对论进动率，对超新星反冲速度机制、双星演化通道以及极端偏心引力波暴源提供了关键物理基准。
analysis.result: 通过 FAST 测时与近星点跟踪，测得双星轨道周期 $P_{\rm orb} = 79.0840618(1)\,{\rm d}$，偏心率高达 $e = 0.99238692(5)$，投影半长轴 $x = 125.54(3)\,{\rm lt\text{-}s}$。在近星点处测得相对速度峰值 $v_{\rm pc,max} = 1.14\times 10^3\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$，加速度达 $Acc_{\rm pc,max} = 1.11\times 10^3\,{\rm m\,s^{-2}}$，最小轨道间距 $S_{\rm pc,min} = 0.83\,R_\odot$。在合相处探测到持续 $85\,{\rm s}$ 的射电掩食（真近点角跨度 $\Delta\theta = 6.84^\circ$），约束轨道近乎侧向视角。通过拟合近星点进动率 $\dot{\omega} = 0.017785(11)\,{\rm deg\,yr^{-1}}$ 及 Shapiro 时延，结合贝叶斯分析测得系统总质量 $m_{\rm t} = 2.814^{+0.018}_{-0.021}\,M_\odot$、脉冲星质量 $m_{\rm p} = 1.38^{+0.06}_{-0.10}\,M_\odot$、伴星质量 $m_{\rm c} = 1.44^{+0.08}_{-0.06}\,M_\odot$ 以及倾角 $i = 76^{\circ+8^\circ}_{-15^\circ}$；限制外加非相对论进动率为 $\dot{\omega}_{\rm EX} = (-1.5^{+0.9}_{-0.8}) \times 10^{-4}\,{\rm deg\,yr^{-1}}$。在引力波（GW）辐射方面，系统在近星点发出周期性脉冲状 GW 暴，平均引力波辐射光度为 $L_{\rm GW} = \frac{32}{5}\frac{G^4m_{\rm p}^2m_{\rm c}^2(m_{\rm p}+m_{\rm c})}{c^5a_{\rm pc}^5(1-e^2)^{7/2}}\left(1+\frac{73}{24}e^2+\frac{37}{96}e^4\right) = 1.9\times 10^{-4}\,L_\odot$，能流峰值频率位于 $f_{\rm p0} \approx \frac{(1+e_0)^{\gamma_{\rm GW}}}{(1-e_0^2)^{3/2}}f_0 = 0.357\,{\rm mHz}$（其中 $\gamma_{\rm GW} = 1.1954$）。

analysis.problem: 传统双中子星形成演化图景中，电子俘获超新星（ECSNe）或超剥离超新星（USSNe）产生的反冲速度较低，难以解释轨道周期长达近 80 天却具有 $e > 0.99$ 的极端偏心 DNS 系统的存在；同时，极端偏心率导致现有经典 DD/DDGR 测时模型中开普勒参数间存在极强的数学协方差，制约后开普勒效应与系统参数的精确提取。
analysis.method: 1. 观测与数据处理：利用 FAST L 波段（1.0–1.5 GHz）进行四偏振脉冲星高时间分辨率数据采集，使用 `DSPSR` 叠加脉冲轮廓，`PSRCHIVE` 提取脉冲到达时间（TOA），并用 `TEMPO2` 建立相位连接的测时解；\n2. 测时模型创新：针对极端离心率导致 $x$ 与 $\omega$ 极高协方差问题，构建了参数重构 $\zeta_1 \equiv x \sin\omega/e$ 和 $\zeta_2 \equiv x \cos\omega \sqrt{1-e^2}$，建立了消除强相关性的 DDe/DDGR+/DDeGR+ 测时模型；\n3. 形成演化模拟：结合 MESA 恒星演化程序模拟初级星经历 Case BB 物质转移吸积与自转加速，并采用双星星族合成计算次级星发生铁核塌缩超新星（Fe CCSNe）所赋予的反冲速度 $V_{\rm k}$（$\sim 200\text{--}800\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$）及其轨道形成概率。
assumptions: 双星引力波辐射及轨道衰减演化遵循广义相对论 Peters-Mathews 方单
limits: 星族合成模拟显示在 $\sigma_{\rm k} = 265\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$ 条件下形成此类高偏心率及相应周期的 DNS 概率极低（$\lesssim 2.5\times 10^{-5}$），表明目前该类型系统的统计演化样本极度受限
